author: Chris Porter
description: While science fiction lore tells us that humans will meet extraterrestrial life in the form of little green men, the detail that should raise hairs this Halloween is this: the search for extraterrestrial intelligence took a major leap forward with AI, and it increasingly focuses on AI agents built by humans listening for AI agents […]
title: Things That Go Beep in the Night: Agentic AI Joins the Search for Extraterrestrial Signals
